map.💵 未签合同双倍工资计算器: 💵 Double Wage for No Written Contract
map.《劳动合同法》第82条：用人单位自用工之日起超过一个月不满一年未与劳动者订立书面: Article 82 of the Labor Contract Law: where an employer fails to conclude a written labor contract with an employee more than one month but less than one year after work begins, it shall pay the employee double wages each month
map.📖 查看「未签合同双倍工资计算器 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Double Wage for No Written Contract User Guide"
map.未签书面劳动合同双倍工资差额 = 月工资 × 未签合同月数；起算自用工之日起满: Double-wage differential for no written contract = monthly wage × number of months without a contract; it runs from the day after the first month of work and covers at most 11 months, since after one year an open-ended contract is deemed concluded. The arbitration limitation is 1 year from the date the party knew or should have known of the infringement.
map.用工之日起满一个月的次日至补订书面劳动合同前一日，最长不超过11个月: From the day after the first month of work to the day before the written contract is concluded, at most 11 months
map.一年，从当事人知道或应当知道其权利被侵害之日起计算: One year from the date the party knew or should have known of the infringement
map.劳动者拒绝签订、已签电子劳动合同、非因用人单位原因未签等情形可能不支持: A claim may fail where the employee refused to sign, an electronic labor contract was concluded, or the failure was not the employer's fault
map.视为已订立无固定期限劳动合同: An open-ended labor contract is deemed concluded
map.📚 深度解析：未签合同双倍工资计算器: 📚 In-depth: Double Wage for No Written Contract
map.用工超过一个月未签书面劳动合同，计算用人单位应支付的双倍工资差额。: Where work has continued over a month with no written contract, compute the double-wage differential the employer owes.
map.双倍工资最长支持 11 个月（自用工满 1 个月起至满 1 年止）。: Double wages are awarded for at most 11 months, from the end of the first month to the end of the first year.
map.满 1 年未签的视为已订立无固定期限合同，不再继续计算双倍工资。: After one year without a contract an open-ended contract is deemed concluded and no further double wages accrue.
map.入职 11 个月未签合同: Eleven months of work with no contract
map.2024-03-01 入职、2025-02-28 离职且始终未签合同，双倍工资期: Starting on 2024-03-01 and leaving on 2025-02-28 with no contract ever signed, the double-wage period is 2024-04 to 2025-02, 11 months; at a monthly salary of ¥8,000 the differential = 8000 × 11 = ¥88,000.
map.满 1 年自动转无固定期: Automatic conversion to open-ended after one year
map.若 2025-03-01 仍在职，自该日起视为订立无固定期限合同，双倍工资计算截: If still employed on 2025-03-01, an open-ended contract is deemed concluded from that date and the double-wage count stops, adding no further months.
map.双倍工资是再发一倍还是两倍的工资？: Is the double wage one extra month's pay or twice the pay?
map.是「差额」一倍，即已发工资外再补发一倍（共相当于两倍），计算基数为劳动者当月应得: It is a differential of one times pay, that is an extra month on top of what was already paid, making two times in all, calculated on the employee's due wage for the month.
map.HR 自己忘签能主张吗？: Can an HR manager claim it?
map.司法实践对具有人事管理职权的高级管理人员是否支持双倍工资存在争议，普通员工一般可: Courts are divided on whether senior managers with personnel authority can claim double wages; ordinary employees generally can. The outcome depends on the evidence and local practice.
